scope: Nine pinned build/config files read whole and Git blob verified; .coveragerc parsed. No build, CI, cleanup, publication or installation command executed.

findings.detail: Makefile alltests invokes testsetup, but no testsetup target is defined. testsetuppost is a different target used by build. Actual py3make execution not performed.

Captured appveyor.yml references compiler/bootstrap helpers absent from pinned tree. Its matrix is Python 2.7/PyPy 2.7, while current metadata requires >=3.7 and setup backup explicitly says Python 2 support dropped.

Tracked .coveragerc duplicates the restricted include list and excludes filetamper/ecc_speedtest/profilers. Thus pyproject review limitation is corroborated by standalone coverage config, not resolved by it.

MANIFEST.in includes test fixtures/results and excludes profiler subtree for source distribution. This is packaging intent; no wheel/sdist built or inspected, so installed test completeness remains unverified.
Codecov uses automatic baseline target and one-percent tolerance, not a universal correctness threshold. No current CI result was inspected.

gitignore excludes /tests/out while current tests live under pyFileFixity/tests. Exact generated test output path is determined by aux_tests, so ignore coverage must be checked against that implementation before running fixture-generating suite.
